CREATE TABLE "public"."Activity" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "entityType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attachment" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "uploadedById" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "authorId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invitation" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invitedById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_role_check_ddb31015" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Label" (
  "color" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Membership" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Membership_role_check_50a44636" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Project" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Project_status_check_aef30f3b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Task" (
  "assigneeId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'TODO' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Task_priority_check_759b7c5e" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH')),
  CONSTRAINT "Task_status_check_b2033264" CHECK ("status" IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TaskLabel" (
  "labelId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "labelId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Workspace" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
